items.html: And behold, you know that in every Sefirah there is Panim and Achor in the aspect of letters and not in the aspect of number; and opposite it, Achor and Panim in the aspect of number. It follows, therefore, that all the aspects of the Achoraim of the number belong to the female clinging to the male, which are the Achoraim of the letters; and they are back to back. And the Panim of the number on one side, and the Panim of the letters on the other side, they do not yet have at all, only the two backs alone. And at the time of the sawing, the Achoraim of the number are sawed from the Achoraim of the aspect of letters.
